verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, and remote robot operation is a fair axis for robotics tooling. However, the evidence documents no teleoperation feature with live video and responsive control over real-world networks. The only related items are gz-transport socket messaging for remote simulation servers and simulated camera sensors, which are developer building blocks rather than a teleoperation capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can teleoperate a remote robot with live video and responsive control over real-world networks
